title: EIP-7732 Breakout Room Call #24, September 26, 2025
agendaMarkdown: #### Specifications & testing New spec release: [v1.6.0-beta.0](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/releases/tag/v1.6.0-beta.0) ##### Open * [eip7732: add tests for `process_withdrawals` block processing](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4468) * [eip7732: add fork choice tests (part1)](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4489) ##### Merged * [Clean up Gloas's presets](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4607) * [Add helper functions for slot time deadlines](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4589) * [eip7732: remove `latest_execution_payload_header`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4598) * [eip7732: clean up `get_attestation_participation_flag_indices`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4583) * [eip7732: add attestation processing tests](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4564) * [eip7732: add tests for execution payload availability reset](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4570) * [eip7732: rename execution payload header to execution payload bid](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4525) #### Implementation updates from client teams * Prysm * Lighthouse * Teku * Nimbus * Lodestar * Grandine #### Plans for `epbs-devnet-0` * Devnet-0 will be based on v1.6.0-beta.0 specifications * Try to provide an `epbs-devnet-0` branch for ethpandaops by the end of October #### Does [`DataColumnSidecar`](https://jtraglia.github.io/eth-spec-viewer/#ssz_objects-DataColumnSidecar) need a `slot` field? See: [the discord message](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/874767108809031740/1420736448893812779) #### It's impossible to keep `latest_execution_payload_header` in [`BeaconState`](https://jtraglia.github.io/eth-spec-viewer/#ssz_objects-BeaconState) See: [the discord message](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/874767108809031740/1420161430497398956)
